overrides.replacement_claim: Sprint summaries, the performance status API, TUI, and server-rendered workbench omit durable operational lifecycle and cancellation state because their aggregate projection bypasses durable-run enrichment.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same projection defect. The aggregate summary uses the raw performance projection, the API returns that aggregate result, and presentation surfaces consume operational fields that this path does not enrich.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance evidence endpoint has a compatibility path that returns an unversioned ad hoc artifact payload instead of the schema-versioned PerformanceEvidenceResult DTO.
overrides.reason: The handler explicitly returns an ad hoc map without schema_version, records, or next_cursor when the optional evidence capability is absent.

overrides.replacement_claim: The public performance configuration table documents hard maxima above the built-in defaults even though validation rejects every value above its built-in default, causing documented supported values to fail configuration loading.
overrides.reason: The documented maxima exceed defaults for multiple fields, while validation uses each default as the configurable ceiling.

overrides.replacement_claim: PerformanceResult returns an unclassified raw error when no terminal result exists, bypassing performance-specific transport error mapping.
overrides.reason: The unavailable-result branch returns a plain error, while performance-specific HTTP mapping recognizes only typed performance use-case errors.

overrides.replacement_claim: The shared operation runner silently discards invalid performance configuration, allowing operations using that runner to continue instead of failing preflight.
overrides.reason: The runner discards the error returned by performanceSettings even though that function can fail while parsing durations or validating limits. Supplied investigator tests reported failure-signature mismatches and do not establish promotion readiness.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance CLI collapses every classified non-cancellation performance failure into the validation exit class, so configuration, runtime, timeout, dependency, and persistence failures do not retain appropriate CLI exit behavior.
overrides.reason: The CLI distinguishes context cancellation only and wraps every other performance failure with ExitValidation.

overrides.replacement_claim: The performance failure path may publish flow state after its verification writer token becomes stale because the final SaveFlowState publication may lack an immediately preceding writer-fence check.
overrides.reason: Both theories concern the same possible stale-writer window. The supplied evidence establishes that SaveFlowState does not enforce a token itself, but does not include sufficient executable observation of ownership changing between the prior fenced publication and flow-state save.

overrides.replacement_claim: ValidateRepairReverification accepts persisted performance reverification records whose nested target results contain invalid performance outcomes or malformed target data because it validates only top-level performance fields and never validates TargetResults.
overrides.reason: The persisted record includes TargetResults, but the shown validator checks only top-level performance authority and outcome fields before returning success.

overrides.replacement_claim: The JSON performance-output parser accepts malformed trailing content after an otherwise valid envelope because it rejects only a second decode that succeeds and does not require io.EOF.
overrides.reason: Any non-nil error from the second decode, including malformed trailing syntax, is treated as acceptable.

overrides.replacement_claim: The bounded performance-evidence API discloses retained artifact paths and digests, and the server-rendered workbench displays evidence digests.
overrides.reason: The public evidence record has JSON-tagged Path and Digest fields, the use-case projection returns records unchanged, and the template renders digests.

overrides.replacement_claim: The TUI exposes mutating performance actions for a disabled project when a historical performance attempt exists.
overrides.reason: The navigation condition admits either enabled policy or an existing attempt, then exposes start and, when an attempt exists, resume, cancel, and recover actions.

overrides.replacement_claim: Fenced or HTML-commented pseudo Performance Targets headings are ignored by target parsing but treated as declarations during disabled-policy validation, causing false performance policy mismatch findings.
overrides.reason: Both theories describe the same inconsistent heading recognition. The target parser tracks fences and comments, while the separate declaration check recognizes matching trimmed heading lines without those exclusions.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance manifest discovery accepts descriptor markers separated from a function declaration by blank lines or additional comments despite requiring the marker to immediately precede the function.
overrides.reason: The discovery loop retains a pending marker while skipping blank and comment lines, contradicting its immediate-precedence contract.

overrides.replacement_claim: Performance-specific defaults and lower-only validation are implemented in the generic platform config package, violating the requirement that product defaults and bounded-context validation remain in the owning product module.
overrides.reason: The platform package defines performance workflow defaults and lower-only product policy, while the architecture criterion reserves product-specific defaults and validation for the owning product module.

issues.claim: Descriptor discovery permits intervening blank or comment lines between a marker and function.
issues.title: Descriptor markers need not immediately precede functions
issues.reason: Discovery accepts source layouts forbidden by the documented closed marker contract.

issues.claim: Documented performance hard maxima above defaults are rejected by runtime validation.
issues.title: Documented performance maxima are unusable
issues.reason: Operators following the public configuration table receive configuration-loading failures for values documented as supported.

issues.claim: PerformanceResult returns a raw unavailable-result error that bypasses performance-specific transport classification.
issues.title: Unavailable performance results lose error classification
issues.reason: The result endpoint falls through generic error handling rather than preserving the performance error category and code.

issues.claim: Public performance evidence responses expose artifact paths and digests, and the workbench renders digests.
issues.title: Performance evidence leaks private artifact metadata
issues.reason: Private retained artifact identifiers are passed directly through public projections rather than an allowlisted metadata DTO.

issues.claim: All non-cancellation performance CLI failures are mapped to ExitValidation.
issues.title: Performance CLI collapses operational exit classes
issues.reason: Runtime, timeout, dependency, persistence, and configuration failures become indistinguishable from validation failures at the CLI boundary.

issues.claim: Disabled historical performance states expose mutating TUI actions.
issues.title: TUI exposes performance mutations while policy is disabled
issues.reason: A historical attempt causes start, resume, cancel, and recover controls to appear despite disabled policy.

issues.claim: The evidence endpoint can return an unversioned fallback shape instead of PerformanceEvidenceResult.
issues.title: Evidence API fallback violates its versioned schema
issues.reason: Supported adapters can produce two incompatible successful response shapes for the same endpoint.

issues.claim: Aggregate performance projections bypass durable-run enrichment and therefore omit operational lifecycle and cancellation state across the status API, TUI, and workbench.
issues.title: Performance surfaces omit durable lifecycle state
issues.reason: Users cannot observe the actual durable lifecycle or cancellation state through surfaces that explicitly present those fields.

issues.claim: Malformed trailing JSON after a valid performance envelope is accepted.
issues.title: Performance JSON parser accepts malformed trailing data
issues.reason: The parser does not require EOF after the envelope, weakening the closed output contract.

issues.claim: The platform config package owns performance-specific defaults and lower-only product validation.
issues.title: Performance product policy is embedded in platform config
issues.reason: Bounded-context policy is placed in a generic platform package contrary to the stated ownership boundary.

issues.claim: Persisted repair performance target results are accepted without nested validation.
issues.title: Repair reverification accepts malformed target results
issues.reason: Malformed persisted target identities or comparison outcomes can pass state validation.

issues.claim: Pseudo Performance Targets headings inside fences or comments trigger disabled-policy mismatch findings.
issues.title: Pseudo target headings cause false policy mismatches
issues.reason: Policy validation and target parsing disagree about whether fenced or commented headings are declarations.

issues.title: Operation runner ignores invalid performance configuration
issues.reason: A known configuration failure can disappear instead of stopping operation setup before side effects.
